environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). Traffic arrives directly to the Flask application on port 8080. No additional middleware or proxy filtering is configured. The ELB performs only TCP health checks on /health. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ELB and ELB to instance on 8080.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB, TCP mode, no HTTP-level inspection
config.network: Public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound from any
